design: Runtime composite of outdoor environment, temperature-dependent character, sky, precipitation and wind. Supersedes 38 flattened weather scenes.

production.characterBackground: True alpha extracted from generated chroma-key masters during asset preparation; no runtime keying.

assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE full-body isolated character sprite for an interactive outdoor weather compositor. Identity/style reference: Use the reference princess: long wavy chestnut-brown hair, large brown eyes, warm peach skin, gold crown with pink heart jewels. Same warm outlined 2D storybook illustration style, pink-and-gold clothing. No shield. Outfit: light pink short-sleeved summer outfit and comfortable shoes, holding a small folded fan at her side. Standing facing camera in a friendly natural pose, both feet on the same horizontal baseline. Entire head, hair, hands and shoes visible with generous 12% empty margin; no cropping. CRITICAL BACKGROUND: a perfectly flat, pure saturated chroma-key green #00FF00 fills every background pixel. No checkerboard, no white background, no transparency simulation, no ground, shadow, landscape, clouds, sun, moon, precipitation, symbols or text. Do not use green in the character or clothes. All lighting neutral and soft; do not tint the character green. The app removes the green as a compositing layer; generate the character only.

Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE square outdoor environment plate for a child's interactive weather scene, no characters or people. Warm outlined softly shaded 2D storybook garden with a pink royal castle far in the background. A quiet paved garden path crosses the lowest 20% of the image for a full-body character to stand on later. Small shrubs and two trees near left and right edges, distant castle at the right edge. Keep the middle 60% uncluttered for the character. Top 50% is a perfectly clear flat pale blue sky, with no sun, moon, clouds or stars. Dry green ground, no snow, rain, fog, wind effects or weather symbols, no text, no frame, no watermark. Day/night and weather are added by app layers. Image must depict a completely outdoor location; no windows, rooms, doors, roofs over the foreground or indoor framing.
